items.title: AI agents are becoming identities in their own right, security needs to catch up
items.summary: As artificial intelligence moves from answering questions to taking actions, cybersecurity faces a fundamental shift. AI agents need identities, constrained permissions and stronger oversight, while AI itself is starting to expose vulnerabilities that have remained hidden in software for years.

items.title: Italian court places Revolut under supervision over money laundering
items.summary: An Italian court has placed Revolut’s European banking unit under judicial administration for one year after finding that inadequate anti-money laundering controls allowed suspected criminals to channel €41.9 million through its accounts between 2021 and 2026
items.interpretation: 这类内容通常反映金融基础设施、监管边界或客户风险控制正在被重新定义，意味着行业真正的竞争将落在合规与规模效率上。
